argument: Every clause has exactly three literals, hence no empty or unit clause and is_2cnf is false.
Distinct variable identities inside each clause exclude a complementary pair x,-x, hence exclude tautology.
Canonical clause representation removes literal duplication/order ambiguity; canonical_formula removes exact duplicate clauses.
Two distinct canonical 3-literal clauses cannot satisfy set(C)<=set(D): equal cardinality would force equality, contradicting duplicate removal.
Take any used variable x and any occurrence literal l on x.
G3 supplies D containing -l with a non-tautological resolvent.
Therefore the opposite polarity exists. Applying this to either initial polarity proves both polarities occur.
This also handles frozen vacuous BCE semantics: absence of any opposite clause would make the literal blocked, contradicting G3.
Frozen first_blocked_clause marks (C,l) blocked exactly when no clause D containing -l yields a non-tautological resolvent.
Negating existence of such a blocked pair is exactly: for every C,l there exists D containing -l with non-tautological resolvent, which is G3.
On simple clauses P_x and N_x are disjoint parent-clause sets because no clause contains both x and -x.
Frozen BVE canonicalizes the distinct non-tautological resolvents R_x and T_x(F).
Its only acceptance branch is |R_x|<=|P_x|+|N_x| AND measure(T_x(F))<measure(F).
G4 is the universal negation of this exact conjunction for every x, hence bve_candidate returns None. G4S is not used.
L0 excludes empty/tautology/unit/subsumption; L1 excludes pure literals; L2 excludes BCE; L3 excludes BVE.
No transformation occurs, so active remains F.
Exact width 3 excludes 2CNF; NOT_HORN excludes Horn.
The frozen R33 fallthrough state is exactly STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE.
On simple exact 3-CNF every R34 group has k=3.
R34 recognizes iff every variable-triple group contains exactly 2^(3-1)=4 distinct falsifying sign assignments and all four have one parity.
Canonical duplicate removal makes repeated identical sign assignments impossible within a group.
G_AFF is the exact negation of this whole-formula condition, hence recognition is false.
With empty assumptions and an unchanged exact 3-CNF, every clause initially has three unassigned literals; therefore initial UP has neither unit nor empty residual clause and halts without conflict.
G5 quantifies over every clause and removed literal and says the exact assumptions used by first_rup_strengthening never produce conflict; therefore proposal=None.
Because no proposal was applied, formula remains F. The final unassumed UP check is identical in relevant state to the initial empty-assumption check and cannot conflict.
run_candidate therefore returns STALLED_RUP_CORE, successful_strengthenings=0, empty history, and final_formula=F.
The independent R35B replay over empty history also sees no unassumed UP conflict and exact final-formula equality, so its replay pass is true.
L4 gives R33 terminal STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE with after_r33=F and empty R33 transformation history.
L5 gives R34 recognized=false.
L6 gives replay-valid R35B status STALLED_RUP_CORE with after_rup=after_r33=F and zero strengthenings.
The controller's RUP_UNSAT branch is not taken; the unchanged-hash branch is taken and sets terminal STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT.
That branch appends the first cycle and breaks before restart assignment; therefore cycle_count=1 and restart_count=0.
R33 and R35B transformation ledgers are empty, so total transformations are zero and residual is literally F.
For C and l on x, bipolarity supplies D containing -l.
D is distinct from C. Linearity permits C and D to share only x.
After resolving on x, the remaining variable identities from C and D are disjoint, so the resolvent cannot contain complementary literals and is non-tautological.
The 15 clauses incident to x have pairwise disjoint two-variable petals outside x by linearity.
There are 7 positive and 8 negative parent clauses, so 7*8=56 parent pairs.
Each pair shares only x, so every resolvent is non-tautological.
The union of two disjoint incident petals uniquely identifies its positive and negative parent pair; hence all 56 resolvents are distinct.
Since 56>15=|P_x|+|N_x|, the frozen BVE acceptance conjunction fails before its measure test.
Two distinct clauses on the same variable triple would share three variable identities and violate linearity.
Thus every variable-triple group has at most one clause, while frozen R34 needs exactly four clauses for a width-3 complete parity bundle.
For a source clause C, an R35B test assigns the two variables of C other than the removed literal so those two source literals are false.
Before scanning C, every other clause intersects C in at most one variable, hence has at most one assigned variable and cannot become unit or empty.
C becomes unit and assigns its third variable.

After all three variables of C are assigned, every other clause still intersects C in at most one variable, hence has at least two unassigned variables unless already satisfied; no further unit or conflict can arise.
Therefore every single-literal RUP test is conflict-free and G5 holds.
15-regular exact 3-CNF has total occurrences 15n and therefore m=5n clauses.
A {7,8} polarity split gives at least 7 positive occurrences per variable, hence at least 7n positive occurrences total.
Horn permits at most one positive literal per clause, hence at most 5n positive occurrences. Since 7n>5n for nonempty n, the formula is not Horn.
S1 supplies G3; S2 supplies G4; S3 supplies G_AFF; S4 supplies G5; S5 supplies NOT_HORN.
Exact simple nonempty 3-CNF is part of the subclass definition, so the main lemma applies conditionally to every formula in this subclass.
No existence, infinitude, treewidth, expansion, or hardness claim follows.
